```python
import os, glob
import pandas as pd

data_files = sorted({p for root in [".", "/mnt/data", "/content", "data", "/home", "/tmp"]
                     if os.path.exists(root)
                     for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(root, "**", "*"), recursive=True)
                     if os.path.isfile(p) and os.path.splitext(p)[1].lower() in {
                         ".csv",".tsv",".json",".jsonl",".parquet",".xlsx",".xls",".feather",".orc",".txt",".yaml",".yml"}})

print("Data/schema files:", data_files or "NONE")
print("DataFrames in session:", {k: v.shape for k, v in globals().items() if isinstance(v, pd.DataFrame)} or "NONE")

# Any schema/contract sidecar registered anywhere?
for name in ["schema", "contract", "data_dictionary", "vocabulary", "ddl", "manifest"]:
    hits = glob.glob(f"**/*{name}*", recursive=True)
    if hits: print(f"{name}:", hits)
```
